posts.zh:
dsh-web-mobile 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏下侧边栏变为贴合内容的 overlay 抽屉、会话独占全宽，设置面板改为近全宽 sheet。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fb07d8b873c9a1b985c3.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-mobile is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mobile-adaptive layout for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes a content-hugging overlay drawer, the conversation gets the full width, and the settings panel becomes a near-full-width sheet.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fb07d8b873c9a1b985c3.html
